units.source_text: 十七日晚上，市长在我下榻的聚乐旅馆举行了招待宴会。

en.t: On the evening of the seventeenth, the mayor held a reception banquet at the Juraku Inn, where I was staying.

units.source_text: 十八日凌晨，我被电话吵醒，说是名人作古了，我旋即奔赴鳞屋去吊唁，然后折回旅馆。

en.t: Before dawn on the eighteenth, I was awakened by a telephone call saying that the Master had passed away; I immediately hurried to Uroko-ya to pay my respects, then returned to the inn.

units.source_text: 吃过早饭，同前来参加红叶节的作家和市工作人员一起参谒了逍遥的墓，并供奉了鲜花。

en.t: After breakfast, together with writers and city staff who had come to take part in the Maple Festival, I visited Shoyo's grave and offered fresh flowers.
After that, I made my way around to the plum garden.

units.source_text: 在抚松庵举行的宴会上，我中途溜了出来，去鳞屋给名人的遗容拍了一张照片。

en.t: During the banquet held at Bushoan, I slipped out partway through and went to Uroko-ya to take a photograph of the Master's face in death.

units.source_text: 过不多久，就目送名人的遗体被运回东京去了。

en.t: Before long, I watched as the Master's remains were taken back to Tokyo.
